question: Where was India’s first commercially approved energy storage system inaugurated?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• South Asia's 'largest' battery energy storage system inaugurated at Delhi's Kilokari.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Delhi Power Minister** inaugurated a **20-MW Battery Energy Storage System (BESS)** at **Kilokari, South Delhi**.

 
 
• 
 
It is **South Asia’s largest utility-scale** and **India’s first commercially approved energy storage system**.

 
 
• 
 
The system has a **40 MWh capacity**.

 
 
• 
 
Enhances **grid stability**, reduces **peak load stress**, and **optimizes power purchase costs**.

 
 
• 
 
Supports **renewable energy integration**.

 
 
• 
 
Uses **Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) technology** – known for **safety** and **thermal stability**.

 
 
• 
 
Performs efficiently under **Delhi’s weather conditions**.

 
 
• 
 
**BESS** stores energy from **solar and wind sources** for **later use**.
